name: flag-atlas
description: A mobile-first adaptive geography learning PWA for flags, country locations, country outlines, and land-border neighbours.

scripts.build: vite build && npm run build:verify && node scripts/finalize-production-build.mjs
scripts.test:pwa-runtime: npm run build && playwright test tests/browser/pwa-runtime.spec.ts --project=chromium
scripts.test:firebase-rules: npm --prefix tests/firebase install && npm --prefix tests/firebase test
scripts.verify: node scripts/verify-vite-build.mjs && node scripts/verify.mjs && node scripts/verify-learning-evidence.mjs && node scripts/verify-map.mjs && node scripts/verify-map-v4-edge.mjs && node scripts/verify-map-insets.mjs && node scripts/verify-routing.mjs && node scripts/verify-ia.mjs && node scripts/verify-icons.mjs && node scripts/verify-cartography.mjs && node scripts/verify-continent-foundation.mjs && node scripts/verify-south-america.mjs && node scripts/verify-europe.mjs && node scripts/verify-asia-expansion.mjs && node scripts/verify-north-america.mjs && node scripts/verify-oceania.mjs && node scripts/verify-map-contrast.mjs && node scripts/verify-map-generation-entry.mjs && node scripts/verify-outline.mjs && node scripts/verify-neighbors.mjs && node scripts/verify-neighbor-map.mjs && node scripts/verify-neighbor-keyboard.mjs && node scripts/verify-mobile-gestures.mjs && node scripts/verify-zero-neighbours.mjs && node scripts/verify-play-feedback.mjs && node scripts/verify-flags-study.mjs && node scripts/verify-domain-integration.mjs && node scripts/verify-achievements.mjs && node scripts/verify-progress-summary.mjs && node scripts/verify-british-english.mjs && node scripts/verify-atlas-brand.mjs && node scripts/verify-action-feedback.mjs && node scripts/verify-design-tokens.mjs && node scripts/verify-spatial-atlas.mjs && node scripts/verify-spatial-disclosure.mjs && node scripts/verify-spatial-framing.mjs && node scripts/verify-spatial-touch.mjs && npm run verify:clean
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:unit && npm run test:firebase-rules && npm run build && npm run verify
scripts.test:spatial: npm run build && playwright test spatial-atlas.spec.ts
